title: Unknown usage
description: The data of a `usage.unknown` event: one accounting unit (an agent run, a model call, a website turn) whose usage the resource ledger could not count, recorded by the Worker source that meters it (design/resources.md, usage the ledger cannot count). Until the ledger counts a usage record of its run in its pool other than its `partial` one (reconciled), a cap of its scope and pool fails closed (INV-2, ADR-0065): it is never counted as 0. Never an estimate of the usage.

runId.description: The unit, as a usage record of it names its `runId` (an agent Worker's run). The unit is reconciled once the ledger counts a record of this run in `pool` that is not its `partial` one.

kind.description: not-reported: the unit ended without its runtime's final count: it reported neither tokens nor turns, or (with `partial`) only what it reported while it ran; interrupted: the host stopped while it ran, so no result came; refused: the ledger refused its usage record (`failure`); failed: recording it failed otherwise (the ledger threw).

pool.description: The pool the unit drew on, as the Worker's configuration names it.

reason.description: Why its usage is unknown, in plain words: how the unit ended (completed, stopped by the operator, past its timeout, stopped by the host's stop or a drain at restart, at a deferred call, failed), and what the runtime reported, or the ledger's own message.

failure.description: Why the ledger refused the record (`ResourcesError`), for `refused`.

record.description: For `refused`: the usage record the ledger refused, kept as an `evidence` artifact (`usage-record@1.0`), so its numbers are not lost; absent when it is not a valid record.

partial.description: For `not-reported` (1.1): the usage record (`receipt`) the ledger counted of what the runtime reported while the unit ran, before it ended without the runtime's final count (a stop, a timeout, a drain, a deferred call). A lower bound, never the unit's usage: it does not reconcile the unit.
